fixture.relationship: Authored explicit-state intervention; differs from matched-state fixture. This is not independent holdout.

system_scope: Qwen/Harrier values are analytical arithmetic estimates for MLX/Metal encoder embedding of each actual query and candidate, not measured GPU FLOPs. Existing explicit Metal timing logs are used only as token-count records; no inference/API calls were made. Laya is analyzed from saved per-question input token lengths and pinned architecture; no output/label/target fields are used.
formula_qwen_harrier: Same formula, config and omissions as results/probes/varied/matched/compute-speed.json; 1 MAC=2 FLOPs; sum independent unpadded query + all candidate strings.

qwen.compute_formula: same as ../matched/compute-speed.json: per unpadded query/candidate string n, L*[n*(4H^2+4H*Hkv+6H*I) + 4H*n(n+1)/2], 1 MAC=2 FLOPs; sums all query/candidate strings per question/case.

harrier.compute_formula: same as ../matched/compute-speed.json: per unpadded query/candidate string n, L*[n*(4H^2+4H*Hkv+6H*I) + 4H*n(n+1)/2], 1 MAC=2 FLOPs; sums all query/candidate strings per question/case.

laya.reason: Both saved matched and explicit Laya runs have 60 rows of exact decisions.*.input_tokens, matching fixture hashes/case counts, pinned checkpoint hash/revision and GPU device metadata; verified encoder config and archived transparent FLOP formula are present. No labels/targets needed.

config.config_architecture: ModernBertForMaskedLM plus pinned two-block decision head from prior compute-comparison formula

laya.formula: Copied exactly from results/laya/mlx/compute_comparison.py: dense encoder MACs L*N*(4H^2+3H*I); encoder attention pairs sum per layer (full: N^2; sliding: sum_i[min(N-1,i+local)-max(0,i-local)+1], local=local_attention//2), cost pairs*2H MAC-equivalent; head MAC estimate 2*N*(4H^2+8H^2)+4N^2H+N*H^2+N*(H+4)*256+256*2. Multiply aggregate by 2 FLOPs/MAC. Per-question cost separately per saved actual input-token length, then sum 3 calls/case. Norms/activations/etc follow prior omissions; analytical arithmetic, not GPU counters.

comparability: Explicit vs matched has different inputs; report FLOP/token deltas, not speedup or accuracy implication. FLOP estimates are not equivalent to effective hardware/GPU operations and cannot be compared as measured utilization.
guardrails: No model inference, API calls, fitting, parameter edits, or label/reference accesses.
Token lengths are read from saved explicit Metal timing logs for Qwen/Harrier and only decisions.*.input_tokens are selected from Laya raw results.
Model arithmetic is analytical from verified configs; do not call GFLOPs measured GPU FLOPs or imply equal effective operations across different architectures.
